persona.zh-CN: 38岁女性，负责迁移项目的进度与协调。极度关注时间表和里程碑，担心任何延期都会影响自己的绩效评估。
persona.en-US: 38-year-old female, responsible for the migration project's schedule and coordination. Extremely focused on timelines and milestones, worried any delay will affect her performance review.

concerns.zh-CN: 能否在原定的8周内完成上线？
concerns.en-US: Can we go live within the original 8 weeks?

concerns.zh-CN: 各数据所有部门能否按时配合？
concerns.en-US: Will each data-owning department cooperate on time?

concerns.zh-CN: 如果延期，如何向高层解释？
concerns.en-US: How to explain to senior management if we slip?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解数据质量问题的严重程度
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the severity of the data quality issues

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了回滚脚本的技术复杂度
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates the technical complexity of the rollback script

blindSpots.zh-CN: 没有意识到数据所有权存在争议
blindSpots.en-US: Is unaware that data ownership is contested

persona.zh-CN: 42岁男性，负责遗留数据库的日常维护。对数据缺陷了如指掌，坚持认为在数据质量达标前不能安全切换。
persona.en-US: 42-year-old male, responsible for day-to-day legacy database maintenance. Knows the data defects intimately and insists cutover is not safe until data quality is acceptable.

concerns.zh-CN: 迁移前如何验证数据完整性？
concerns.en-US: How do we verify data integrity before migration?

concerns.zh-CN: 回滚能否在2小时内完成？
concerns.en-US: Can the rollback complete within 2 hours?

concerns.zh-CN: 字段映射规则由谁来最终确认？
concerns.en-US: Who ultimately confirms the field-mapping rules?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 过于关注技术风险而忽视商业时间压力
blindSpots.en-US: Over-focuses on technical risk while ignoring commercial time pressure

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解高层对ROI和监管期限的焦虑
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand leadership's anxiety about ROI and regulatory deadlines

persona.zh-CN: 45岁女性，名义上负责企业数据资产，但多个数据域的实际所有权分散在不同业务部门。对责任边界态度模糊，担心被追责。
persona.en-US: 45-year-old female, nominally responsible for enterprise data assets, but actual ownership of several data domains is split across business departments. Ambiguous about responsibility boundaries and worried about being held accountable.

concerns.zh-CN: 哪些数据域由我负责，哪些不属于我？
concerns.en-US: Which data domains am I responsible for, and which are not mine?

concerns.zh-CN: 如果迁移出错，责任如何划分？
concerns.en-US: If the migration goes wrong, how is responsibility divided?

concerns.zh-CN: 是否有人愿意签署数据移交确认书？
concerns.en-US: Is anyone willing to sign the data handover confirmation?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解字段缺失的具体分布
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know the specific distribution of missing fields

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了遗留系统缺少数据字典的影响
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates the impact of the legacy system's missing data dictionary

persona.zh-CN: 50岁男性，控制项目预算。强调每一笔支出都要有明确回报，反对超支，倾向压缩外部专家投入。
persona.en-US: 50-year-old male, controls the project budget. Emphasizes a clear return on every expense, opposes overspending, and favors cutting external expert spending.

concerns.zh-CN: 迁移的总成本是否在预算内？
concerns.en-US: Is the total migration cost within budget?

concerns.zh-CN: 额外资源申请能否带来可量化的风险下降？
concerns.en-US: Do additional resource requests bring quantifiable risk reduction?

concerns.zh-CN: 迁移失败会导致多少财务损失？
concerns.en-US: How much financial loss would a failed migration cause?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不理解数据治理需要专业人力投入
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand that data governance needs professional staffing

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了数据错误带来的合规与声誉成本
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates the compliance and reputational cost of data errors

text.zh-CN: 迁移涉及约3,200万条订单记录和15张相互关联的数据表
text.en-US: The migration covers about 32 million order records across 15 interrelated tables

text.zh-CN: 数据所有权分散：订单数据归销售部，客户数据归市场部，库存数据归运营部，没有单一端到端负责人
text.en-US: Data ownership is fragmented: order data belongs to Sales, customer data to Marketing, inventory data to Operations — there is no single end-to-end owner

text.zh-CN: 迁移准备中的抽样验证发现约12%的记录存在字段缺失或格式不一致
text.en-US: Sampling during migration preparation found about 12% of records have missing fields or inconsistent formats

text.zh-CN: 团队每周要花两天时间手工核对数据，仍然不断发现新的异常
text.en-US: The team spends two days a week manually reconciling data, yet keeps finding new anomalies

text.zh-CN: 遗留数据库已有18年历史，经历过7次未记录在案的应急修改
text.en-US: The legacy database is 18 years old and has undergone 7 undocumented emergency changes

text.zh-CN: 系统缺少数据字典，字段含义依赖三位资深工程师的个人记忆，其中一位已于去年离职
text.en-US: There is no data dictionary; field meanings rely on the personal memory of three senior engineers, one of whom left last year

text.zh-CN: 如果迁移失败导致订单处理中断，每天的营收损失约为40万美元
text.en-US: If a failed migration interrupts order processing, the daily revenue loss is about $400,000

text.zh-CN: 监管要求在下个财季前完成数据可审计性改造，逾期将面临合规处罚
text.en-US: Regulators require auditable data by next fiscal quarter; missing the deadline risks compliance penalties

text.zh-CN: 上线窗口只有8周，且迁移必须在周末夜间进行以最小化停机
text.en-US: The go-live window is only 8 weeks, and migration must run on weekend nights to minimize downtime

text.zh-CN: 预算只够一套迁移工具和两名合同工程师，无法聘请外部数据治理专家
text.en-US: The budget covers only one migration tool and two contract engineers; no budget for external data-governance experts

text.zh-CN: 成功标准是99.99%的记录在切换后通过完整性校验，且回滚时间不超过2小时
text.en-US: Success means 99.99% of records pass integrity checks after cutover, with rollback under 2 hours

text.zh-CN: 管理层希望迁移后订单查询延迟降低60%，为后续AI应用打下基础
text.en-US: Management wants order-query latency reduced by 60% after migration, laying the groundwork for future AI applications

text.zh-CN: 项目经理坚持按原定8周上线，技术负责人认为数据质量不足以安全切换，两人公开争执
text.en-US: The project manager insists on the original 8-week go-live, while the technical lead believes data quality is not yet safe for cutover; they argue openly

text.zh-CN: 数据负责人担心被追究责任，对关键数据问题给出模糊回答
text.en-US: The data owner fears being held accountable and gives vague answers on critical data issues

text.zh-CN: 如果回滚脚本未能在2小时内生效，新旧系统会同时写入，造成难以修复的数据分叉
text.en-US: If the rollback script fails to take effect within 2 hours, old and new systems write simultaneously, causing hard-to-repair data divergence

text.zh-CN: 部分数据在迁移中可能被静默截断（字段超长），且现有校验逻辑不会报错
text.en-US: Some data may be silently truncated during migration (over-length fields), and the existing validation logic will not flag it
